title: Product Feature Callout Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Show one product detail in a focused callout video from a single photo. Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds for feeds, listings and product pages.
h1: Product Feature Callout Video for One Clear Detail
lead: Keep one function in frame, then add the feature name after the file downloads.
steps_h2: Make a Product Feature Video in 3 Steps
steps_lead: One action, one function. The feature name and any measurement go on after download.

steps.d: Upload one sharp photo that shows the whole product and the moving part. Skip glare and tight crops.
Describe the one action around that feature, then pick a size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the clip and add the feature name or measurement in your editor. Check it against the real item.

faq.q: What is a product feature callout video?
faq.a: A short clip built around one visible function, such as a pump, a lid, a hinge or a clasp. The name of that function is added after download.

faq.q: How do I make the callout?
faq.a: Upload a photo that shows the whole item and the moving part, describe that one action, pick a size and length, then download.

faq.q: Why not explain every benefit in one clip?
faq.a: One action stays readable on a phone. A second feature belongs in another version, made from the same photo if you want.
Beauty, electronics and other shops that need a listing or a paid ad to show how one part works.
A sharp, evenly lit photo with the full product and the moving part visible. Glare, a tight crop or a hidden hinge makes the function hard to read.

faq.q: Which size and length should I pick?
faq.a: 9:16 for TikTok and Reels, 1:1 for a feed or listing, 16:9 for a product page, plus 4:3 or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.

faq.q: Can I print the measurement on the video here?
faq.a: Add the feature name, size or claim in your editor after download, and check it against the real product before you post.

faq.q: Do I need a shoot to show the motion?
faq.a: Start from one still photo and describe the action. Review the result before you decide a separate shoot is needed.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. You see the cost first. A failed job returns its credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Can I post it as an ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark. Any person in frame is an AI performer, not a customer review, and captions are added after download.

steps.sourceAlt: Plain white cleanser pump bottle photographed alone on a light background.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the full bottle and pump head visible.
steps.prompt: Beside a clean sink, a hand presses the white cleanser pump once. The bottle stays upright and fully visible, and a little foam shows on the fingertips.

reviews.h2: Sample Single Benefit Product Video Uses
reviews.lead: Example scenes for a single function. One moving part per clip.

items.d: A beauty shop presses the cleanser pump once, so that one action is the whole clip.
Example: hands open a travel-mug lid so the seal is the feature on screen.
Example: a hinged storage lid opens once so the mechanism stays in frame.
Example: a clasp on a ceramic container is rotated toward the camera.
Example: one port is held to camera so a listing can show where the cable goes.
Example: a zipper travels once along the track so the hardware is the point of the clip.
Example: a strap shortens once so the fit hardware is easy to see.
Example: a lid locks shut in one motion for a product-page loop.
Example: a cap turns off so the closure, not the whole routine, is the subject.
Example: one button is pressed so the control is readable without a second feature in frame.
